settings.title: Hi, I'm Whatshername — I make loud, feeling-first art.

settings.editor: I'm a contemporary painter working in acrylic and mixed media. My work is about big feelings and the colours that come with them — joy, noise, restlessness and calm.
Based in London, I show work in galleries, paint murals, and make limited prints so the art can live in more homes.
Every piece starts as an emotion, not a plan. The colour follows the feeling.
I use the loudest colours I can find and let them argue with each other.
Art shouldn't sit in storage. I make work — and prints — meant for real walls.
A full room of large-scale canvases exploring stillness inside chaos. Sold out on opening night.
Opened a small-batch print studio to make the work affordable and accessible to more collectors.
Three city-centre murals commissioned to brighten overlooked corners of the high street.
The debut body of work that set the palette and energy the studio is known for today.
